//: Anti-detect thresholds for the validation harness (T-005). GATED (fails the run.mjs verdict + exit code): sannysoft.maxFailed and the webrtc leak checks. MEASURED-ONLY (reported in the JSON, never fails this harness): creepjs and coherence. The only threshold NUMBER run.mjs reads is sannysoft.maxFailed; the webrtc booleans document intent that the harness enforces in code; creepjs/coherence values are targets, not gates.

sannysoft.note: GATED. WebGL Vendor/Renderer are native (deep) surfaces handled by Lobium; they read the host GPU until the Lobium build ships, so up to 2 WebGL fails are expected/allowed here.

creepjs.note: MEASUREMENT ONLY — not enforced by run.mjs. CreepJS runs only when LOBSTER_CREEPJS=1 and its trust/lies are reported in detectorMatrix, never compared to these numbers (JS deep-surface spoofing is itself the tell CreepJS detects, so trust stays low until Lobium's native patches land). minTrustScore/maxLies are the target for the Lobium build, not a current gate.

webrtc.note: GATED by the harness webrtcLeakProtected check (the booleans here document intent; the checks live in run.mjs): (1) the profile's own host candidates are all mDNS .local (no raw private IPv4 / no global IPv6), and (2) with disable_non_proxied_udp + a live STUN server the browser emits NO public-IP srflx. The suppression assertion (2) only counts once a CONTROL run (default_public_interface_only + STUN) proves the probe CAN leak; if the control does not leak (no network/STUN), webrtcLeakProtected is reported as not-measured (null) and skipped rather than a vacuous pass. requireIcePublicIpEqualsProxyIp — asserting a srflx equals the PROXY egress IP — needs a live test proxy and is a follow-up (T-019a).

coherence.note: MEASUREMENT ONLY in this harness — run.mjs derives a coherent fingerprint but does not re-run a coherence gate against maxIssues. Coherence is enforced upstream by the @lobster/fingerprint unit tests (validateFingerprintCoherence over the 50-seed x OS x engine sweep).
